refnamediv.refpurpose: Sets options on the specified context

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.description;
truestream_context_set_options resourcecontext arrayoptions
Sets options on the specified context. The options are merged into the existing ones per option name: a value that is replaced is overwritten as a whole, &null; is stored rather than removing the option, and [] changes nothing.
On a stream that already carries the default context, such as a socket opened without a context, the options are written into the default context, and outlive the stream. Any other stream, such as a plain file, gets a private context and leaves the default one untouched.

&reftitle.parameters;
context
The stream or context resource to apply the options to.
options
The options to set for context.
options must be an associative &array; of associative arrays in the format $array['wrapper']['option'] = $value.
Refer to context options and parameters for a listing of stream options.
